name: Subarashiki Hibi ~Furenzoku Sonzai~
original_name: 素晴らしき日々～不連続存在～
source:
One day, Minakami Yuki witnesses a stuffed toy falling through the air. Battered and worn, how many times has this doll fluttered downwards, released as an attempted offering to the sky? An offering made to find the "day we return to the sky"—a ritual passed down in this town since times gone by. Those efforts shall come to fruition in the place where the girls of earth and sky meet.

Vega and Altair—Orihime and Hikoboshi—two points of light separated by the vast Milky Way.

Together with Deneb, crown of the Northern Cross, they make up the Summer Triangle. Evoking the concept of the Trinity, this formation is also known as the "Heavenly Triangle." When this Heavenly Triangle shines overhead, the world and the sky will meet.

Takashima Zakuro, Wakatsuki Kagami, Wakatsuki Tsukasa, and our heroine, Minakami Yuki, set off in search of that place where the points of the divine triangle cross—where world and sky join together.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/658620/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
一天，水上由岐目睹一个毛绒玩具从空中坠落。这个伤痕累累、破旧不堪的玩偶，究竟曾多少次作为献给天空的供品飘落？那是为了寻找“我们回归天空之日”而进行的献祭，是小镇自古流传的仪式。所有努力终将在大地少女与天空少女相遇之处开花结果。

织女星与牛郎星——织姬与彦星——是被浩瀚银河分隔的两点光芒。

它们与北十字之冠天津四共同构成夏季大三角。令人联想到三位一体的这一星群，也被称为“天之三角”。当天之三角在头顶闪耀时，世界与天空便会相会。

高岛柘榴、若槻镜、若槻司，以及主人公水上由岐，共同出发寻找神圣三角交点所在之处——世界与天空相连的地方。
